steps.name: a2p-1-bar
steps.title: Picker bar: two commands, the guarded admin hand-off, dropdown skeleton
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; V="${DELEGATE_EVIDENCE_DIR:-/tmp}/verify-a2p1.log"; timeout 1500 python3 tools/run_tests.py > "$V" 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -25 "$V"; test "$rc" -eq 0 || exit 1; for m in hub.tests.test_a2p_bar hub.tests.test_sessions_ui hub.tests.test_ui hub.tests.test_anonymity hub.tests.test_image_imports; do grep -qE "^ok +$m " "$V" || { echo "MISSING OR FAILED $m"; grep -E '^ok |^FAIL' "$V" | head -40; exit 1; }; done; ! grep -qE '^FAIL +|^not ok' "$V" || exit 1; test -f hub/tests/test_a2p_bar.py || { echo NO NEW MODULE; exit 1; }; git diff --name-only "$(git merge-base HEAD a2-steps-6-8)" | grep -qx 'hub/tests/test_sessions_ui.py' || { echo test_sessions_ui.py NOT REWRITTEN; exit 1; }; grep -q 'buildAdminHandoffUrl' hub/static/admin_link.js || { echo NO GUARD FN; exit 1; }; ! git diff "$(git merge-base HEAD a2-steps-6-8)" -- hub/static | grep -E '^\+' | grep -q 'innerHTML' || { echo INNERHTML ADDED; exit 1; }; ! { git diff --name-only "$(git merge-base HEAD a2-steps-6-8)"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | grep -vE '^(docs/specs/a2p-[a-z0-9-]+[.]md|docs/specs/a2p-chain[.]json|hub/static/(index[.]html|app[.]css|state[.]js|admin_link[.]js|views/sessions[.]js)|hub/tests/test_(a2p_bar|sessions_ui)[.]py)$' || { echo SCOPE VIOLATION; exit 1; }

steps.name: a2p-2-dropdown
steps.title: Dropdown contents: sections, one-shot OpenCode, admin stop, states, keyboard
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; P=delegate/a2p-1-bar; V="${DELEGATE_EVIDENCE_DIR:-/tmp}/verify-a2p2.log"; git rev-parse --verify "$P" >/dev/null; timeout 1500 python3 tools/run_tests.py > "$V" 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -25 "$V"; test "$rc" -eq 0 || exit 1; for m in hub.tests.test_a2p_dropdown hub.tests.test_a2p_bar hub.tests.test_sessions_ui hub.tests.test_ui hub.tests.test_anonymity hub.tests.test_image_imports; do grep -qE "^ok +$m " "$V" || { echo "MISSING OR FAILED $m"; grep -E '^ok |^FAIL' "$V" | head -40; exit 1; }; done; ! grep -qE '^FAIL +|^not ok' "$V" || exit 1; test -f hub/tests/test_a2p_dropdown.py || { echo NO NEW MODULE; exit 1; }; grep -q 'test.*stop' hub/tests/test_a2p_dropdown.py || { echo NO FLOW TEST; exit 1; }; ! git diff "$(git merge-base HEAD "$P")" -- hub/static | grep -E '^\+' | grep -q 'innerHTML' || { echo INNERHTML ADDED; exit 1; }; ! { git diff --name-only "$(git merge-base HEAD "$P")"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | grep -vE '^(hub/static/(app[.]css|views/(sessions|claude|running)[.]js)|hub/tests/test_(a2p_dropdown|sessions_ui)[.]py)$' || { echo SCOPE VIOLATION; exit 1; }

steps.name: a2p-3-screenshots
steps.title: Screenshot acceptance at both viewports and themes; polish and the slice gate
steps.verify: set -o pipefail; P=delegate/a2p-2-dropdown; V="${DELEGATE_EVIDENCE_DIR:-/tmp}/verify-a2p3.log"; git rev-parse --verify "$P" >/dev/null; timeout 1500 python3 tools/run_tests.py > "$V" 2>&1; rc=$?; tail -25 "$V"; test "$rc" -eq 0 || exit 1; for m in hub.tests.test_a2p_browser hub.tests.test_a2p_bar hub.tests.test_a2p_dropdown hub.tests.test_sessions_ui hub.tests.test_ui hub.tests.test_anonymity hub.tests.test_image_imports; do grep -qE "^ok +$m " "$V" || { echo "MISSING OR FAILED $m"; grep -E '^ok |^FAIL' "$V" | head -40; exit 1; }; done; ! grep -qE '^FAIL +|^not ok' "$V" || exit 1; D="${DELEGATE_EVIDENCE_DIR:-/tmp}/a2p-shots"; for f in 390x800-light-closed 390x800-light-open 390x800-dark-closed 390x800-dark-open 1440x900-light-closed 1440x900-light-open 1440x900-dark-closed 1440x900-dark-open; do test -s "$D/$f.png" || { echo "MISSING SHOT $D/$f.png"; exit 1; }; done; ! { git diff --name-only "$(git merge-base HEAD "$P")"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | grep -vE '^(hub/static/(app[.]css|index[.]html|views/sessions[.]js)|hub/tests/test_a2p_browser[.]py)$' || { echo SCOPE VIOLATION; exit 1; }
